name: Faebie Set
description: Odran Lineless, a Faebie jeweller born of a halfling and a gnome, cut the first pair, the one Shadeheart wore on the day she refused to cover her antlers. Since then, every Faebie house keeps a pair under lock and key. It gives the pair to the Scothan of its choosing, on the evening they first step through its widened doors.

2.text: At the end of a {{repos-long}}, you can replace the Skill you chose with {{CHAIRX-001}}, the one you chose with {{SANAUT-001}}, or both, with another from the same Species and the same subspecies or regional origin.
